'''Mieczysław Wilczek''' (25 January 1932 – 30 April 2014) was a [[Polish people|Polish]] politician, chemist, and businessman who was [[Minister of Industry]] from 1988 to 1989.<ref>{{cite news|url=https://www.economist.com/blogs/easternapproaches/2014/05/polish-business |title=Polish business: Mieczyslaw Wilczek's law |newspaper=The Economist |date=16 May 2014 |accessdate=22 May 2014}}</ref><ref>{{cite web|url=http://tvn24bis.pl/informacje,187/mieczyslaw-wilczek-nie-zyje-zmarl-ostatni-minister-przemyslu-prl,423640.html |title=Mieczysław Wilczek nie żyje. Zmarł ostatni minister przemysłu PRL – TVN24 BiŚ |publisher=Tvn24bis.pl |accessdate=22 May 2014 |language=Polish}}</ref>
